description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ChargeCannotBeDeletedException' which extends an abstract exception class. It is used within the charge exception package of the Fineract platform to indicate a failure to delete a charge.

classes.name: ChargeCannotBeDeletedException
classes.description: A specialized exception indicating that a charge cannot be deleted, extending the platform's abstract domain rule exception.

methods.name: ChargeCannotBeDeletedException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with localization message code, default user message, and optional message arguments.
